_doc: What Neel (ElevenLabs) gets wrong, and what the owner does not want to hear. scripts/elevenlabs/tts_check.py reads this before every recording and refuses to record while anything here is in narration.hi.md. Add every new finding the day it is found. 'verified': words of names and English terms already heard correctly (probe_words.py skips them).

नए.use: अलग / अभी अभी बने / बिल्कुल अलग (rephrase)
नए.why: Neel says it like नहीं: 'नए idea' was heard as 'नहीं' (video 04 ch7, 03 gold Short, 2026-10-26)

नई.why: same risk as नए (it is the same word)

COBE.why: an acronym: Neel may spell it out; कोबी came out as 'COBE' (04-x ch4)

WMAP.why: an acronym Neel would guess at

सरसराहट.why: owner did not like the word (04-x hook, 2026-10-27)

गहनों.use: planet / दुनिया (say what the gold is part of)
गहनों.why: owner: 'Remove गहनों with planet' (gold Short hook)

naye.use: alag / abhi abhi bane / bilkul alag (rephrase)
naye.why: Roman form of नए: Neel says it like nahi

sarsarahat.why: owner did not like the word

Voyager 1.why: in Hinglish Neel reads the digit in Hindi: 'Voyager ek' (probe, 2026-10-29); captions keep 'Voyager 1'
